title: wtsi-hgi/hlarnaseq pipeline - params.wgs_samples schema
description: Schema for the WGS samples manifest provided with params.wgs_samples

WGS_sample_id.errorMessage: WGS sample ID must be provided and cannot contain spaces

WGS_BAM_path.errorMessage: WGS alignment path must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.bam' or '.cram'

WGS_BAI_path.errorMessage: WGS index path must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must be named '<alignment file name>.bai' for a BAM (i.e. end in '.bam.bai') or '<alignment file name>.crai' for a CRAM (i.e. end in '.cram.crai'), because HLA-LA resolves the index by appending '.bai'/'.crai' to the alignment path and will not find an index named otherwise
WGS_BAI_path must be a CRAM index ('<CRAM file name>.crai') when WGS_BAM_path is a CRAM
WGS_BAI_path must be a BAM index ('<BAM file name>.bai') when WGS_BAM_path is a BAM
